changes.title: Remove legend buffs
items: Legend buffs are gone for good (nothing gave them any more): the game plays exactly as before

changes.title: Attack look species
items: Every creature's attack wears its own magic: squirrels lob acorns, martens throw pinecones, beavers roll logs, otters skim pebbles, raccoons fling cans, owls and ravens send shadowy feathers; water, sand, wood and wind join fire, frost, venom, storm, earth, shadow, moonlight and bloom

changes.title: Sigils default
items: The new sigils are now the default: bare glyphs in their rank's colour (baby turquoise, youth purple, adult red, legend yellow) with embers, a youth's berries as dots beside it in your stack, rune stones glowing in their area's top rank, and placed sigils on a roomier 6 m grid (?sigils=old for the old look)
